methodology: 30 AB/BA alternating serial pairs per case on same GPU/toolchain. Every job is a fresh one-shot native process, first sample marked. Explicit in-process offline Runtime fixture with experimental per-build discovery identity; ordinary production qualification remains fail-closed. Includes real authenticated HTTP upload/preflight/packing/queue/supervisor/native/cleanup/result retrieval and browser binding validation; excludes ordinary production qualification file/environment verification because candidate is deliberately unbound. No Nsight, sanitizer, or allocation instrumentation in timing runs. RSS/allocation/CUDA activity collected separately. Same unchanged STATIC executable for both control labels.
